definitions.cohort: fixtures where C, C2, C3, C5, C6, M, D, A, C0, DC all have a score
definitions.differences: X_minus_Y is X minus Y log loss: positive means X is worse
definitions.information_test: p ~ M^a * R^b, maximum likelihood on 1X2; passes only when b on development is positive with its interval clear of zero
definitions.intervals: whole calendar weeks resampled, 2000 draws, seed 136, 95%
definitions.quote_reference_cohort: every fixture with M and both quote references (no research view needed)

segments.favourite market probability: the larger of M's home and away probability: under 45%, 45-60%, 60-75%, 75%+
segments.league: each league; sharpness is the t minimising the 1X2 log loss of p^t
segments.month: kickoff in August or September, against the rest
segments.training matches: either team with fewer than 16 matches in the fold's training rows, against the rest

notes: Reporting only: nothing here selects, stakes or changes a live probability.
No holdout row is read. Validation and retrospective were already inspected; they are diagnostics, never release evidence.
The retrospective market reference is Bet365 with the margin removed, not Pinnacle.
Historical prices are pre-match snapshots without timestamps; returns are not claimed as achievable.
